card: ROLE: white horse gifted to Bari by Othon Von Salza; bonded companion on Okhar
TRAIT: specimen of a horse breed extinct for 20,000 years since the Sixth World War
TRAIT: recreated by imperial techno-scientists from the Imperial Palace genetic museum at a cost of 100 tons of gold
TRAIT: presence on Okhar described as a godsend during a gloomy season
TRAIT: vulnerable to synthetic mare essence; this vulnerability was exploited by armed raiders who stole him
TRAIT: the raiding expedition that stole him included Ulkran, Wulthor, Tokkar, and Bargoth, who used synthetic mare essence to take him
TRAIT: bonds and becomes docile when named and fed sugar by a person
TRAIT: bonded to Bari after Bari named him and fed him sugar
RELATIONSHIP: bari (Bari): bonded master; bond formed when Bari named him and fed him sugar
RELATIONSHIP: othon-von-salza (Othon Von Salza): original acquirer who gifted him to Bari; after Othon was catastrophically wounded in the fog ambush, Shazam carried him home to the palace
VOICE: non-speaking animal; behavioral presence only; no interior voice, symbolic awareness, or knowledge of events beyond direct experience
INSTRUCTION: portray through animal behavior only — bonding responses, carrying, vulnerability to synthetic mare essence; no human interiority or symbolic reflection

BOUNDARY: no speech, self-awareness, symbolic interiority, or knowledge of household or lineage consequences; behavior is limited to bonding, vulnerability to synthetic mare essence, and carrying riders
